# Platform privilege profiles

Each service or job of a platform names exactly one profile, and its privileges are exactly that profile's grants (contract v2). A manifest adds only its own state directories, secrets, limits within the caps below and the one fixed relaxation. Source: `contract/profiles.yml`.

| Profile | Database | Incus | Telemetry | Inference and GPU | Restricted data | Filesystem | Network |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `controller` | own login role; table grants from migrations, `restricted` schema allowed | restricted certificate for projects `bench` and `build`; run networks only through the run-network helper (§7.7) | send; query Prometheus, Loki, Tempo through the query proxy only | inference API; the only service that may request GPU arbiter transitions (serve, train, idle, publish a dataset); never GPU devices | read | release (read); own config, secrets and state; signing key (0400); attestations and trusted keys, session records, fingerprint, models, adapter lineage (read) | loopback only, also with remote inference (§12.8); no listening TCP port |
| `inference-broker` | own login role; never `restricted` | none | send | inference API | never | release; own config, secrets, state | loopback only, also with remote inference (§12.8); may listen on exactly one port, the researcher endpoint `127.0.0.1:18705` |
| `sandbox-operator` | own login role; never `restricted` | restricted certificate for project `bench` | send; query (via proxy) | none | never | release; own config, secrets, state | loopback only, no listening port |
| `restricted-operator` | own login role; `restricted` allowed | restricted certificate for project `bench` | send | none | read | release; own config, secrets, state | loopback only, no listening port |
| `restricted-reader` | own login role; `restricted` allowed | none | send; query through the query proxy only | none | read | release; own config, secrets, state; optional tools | loopback only, no listening port |
| `observer` | own login role; never `restricted` | none | send; query through the query proxy only | none | never | release; own config, secrets, state | loopback only, no listening port |
| `untrusted-agent` | none: no role, database socket directories hidden | none | send only, through infra's separate agent OTLP socket; no query | none directly; only through a dedicated broker socket the manifest declares | never | allowlist: release (read), own state, own non-secret config, its dedicated sockets; the rest of `/srv/pinka`, `/etc/pinka`, `/var/lib/pinka`, `/run/pinka` hidden | none (`PrivateNetwork=yes`, Unix sockets only) |
| `gpu-trainer` | none | none | none; progress goes to the job log and a metrics file in its output directory | the GPU through CDI, only while the arbiter is in training mode for this job | never | mounts only: base model (read-only), declared datasets (read-only), its output and checkpoint directory (read-write); read-only root file system | none (`--network none`) |

## Who may use a socket

Root can always connect. A socket the agent uses is dedicated to it (`untrusted_clients: true`) and lists `untrusted-agent` as its only client.

| Served by | May be used by | The agent |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `controller` | `controller`, `inference-broker`, `sandbox-operator`, `restricted-operator`, `restricted-reader`, `observer`, researchers, admins, root | `untrusted-agent` only on a dedicated socket |
| `inference-broker` | `controller`, researchers, root | `untrusted-agent` only on a dedicated socket |
| `sandbox-operator` | `controller`, root | `untrusted-agent` only on a dedicated socket |
| `restricted-operator` | `controller`, root | never `untrusted-agent` |
| `restricted-reader` | `controller`, root | never `untrusted-agent` |
| `observer` | `controller`, `inference-broker`, `sandbox-operator`, `restricted-operator`, `restricted-reader`, `observer`, researchers, admins, root | never `untrusted-agent` |
| `untrusted-agent` | serves no sockets | — |
| `gpu-trainer` | serves no sockets | — |

## The agent's own package

A service of `untrusted-agent` names its own package in the manifest (`package`, required) and sees only that package and its own environment of the release, never the rest of it: no other package, no migrations, policy bundle, docs or dashboards (approved deviation V6, which narrows the release in the table above). For `python-uv` the package is a workspace member; the build installs it with only its locked dependencies into `.agent-venvs/<service>/`, and a start command below `.venv/` runs from there. Every dependency must come from an `https://` package index: a manifest whose agent package depends, directly or through others, on another package of the release, or on a path, Git or URL source, is refused. For `static` the package is the directory the agent runs from.

## Facilities

A manifest declares in `requires` every infra facility it uses; the health gate checks exactly these. It is refused when a service or job of one of these profiles, or one of these fields, needs a facility it does not declare. A field counts when it is present and not false or empty.

| Facility | What it is | Needed by profiles | Needed by fields |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `postgres` | the platform database, its roles and the socket directories | — | `backup.database` |
| `incus` | the restricted Incus certificate, projects and run networks | `sandbox-operator`, `restricted-operator` | — |
| `telemetry` | the collector, the query proxy and Grafana | — | `dashboards`, `telemetry` |
| `inference` | the inference API (vLLM, or the forwarder on a lab node) | `inference-broker` | — |
| `opa` | the policy engine with the platform's bundle | — | `policy` |
| `gpu` | the GPU arbiter, which also runs CPU-only jobs | `gpu-trainer` | — |

## Caps

| Cap | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `service_memory_max` | `16G` |
| `service_tasks_max` | `4096` |
| `hook_timeout_seconds` | `3600` |
| `job_timeout_seconds` | `86400` |
| `job_memory_max` | `64G` |
| `job_cpus` | `32` |
| `job_gpus` | `1` |
| `telemetry_labels` | `4` |
| `manifest_bytes` | `262144` |

## Relaxations

| Relaxation | Effect | Change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wx-memory` | turns off MemoryDenyWriteExecute, which Quarto needs | `MemoryDenyWriteExecute=no` |
